newsitem.title: USA: Playboy to launch Croatian edition.
newsitem.headline: Playboy to launch Croatian edition.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc said Tuesday it will begin publishing a Croatian edition of its monthly Playboy magazine starting in December.
It will be Playboy's 16th overseas edition.
Vladimir Tomic, a Zagreb-based journalist, was appointed editor-in-chief of the new edition.
The Croatian edition will initially be published in Croatia, Bosnia and Slovenia, and may also become available in Serbia and Montenegro, Playboy said.

"For many years, prior to the recent conflicts, Yugoslavia was considered by many to be the most independent and progressive country in the Eastern bloc," Playboy senior vice president Robert O'Donnell said in a statement. "The people of the region are highly literate and eager to learn more about the ideas and lifestyles of the West."
